name.en-US: Letter to Bassiano of Lodi on the 30 Articles
name.la: Epistola ad Bassianum Laudensem de 30 Articulis
name.pt-BR: Carta a Bassiano de Lodi sobre os 30 Artigos

description.en-US: A response Aquinas wrote to Bassiano, lector at Lodi, answering 30 doctrinal questions on the Trinity, Christology, sacraments, and demonology.
description.la: Responsum Thomae Bassiano lectori Laudensi, ad 30 quaestiones doctrinales de Trinitate, Christologia, sacramentis, daemonologia.
description.pt-BR: Resposta de Tomás a Bassiano, leitor em Lodi, a 30 questões doutrinais sobre a Trindade, a cristologia, os sacramentos e a demonologia.

sources.description: Latin text from the Leonine / Marietti editions (public domain), mirrored from aquinas.cc. No public-domain English translation available.
